title: New trailer for my cozy city-building match 3 game Mergeopolis
author: re-skob
selftext:
Just updated my Steam page with a new trailer since there've been a ton of art updates. I've been working on this game on and off for around a year since I got laid off last year. I started it in Unity, got a prototype, dropped it for some other projects, brought it back and ported it to 3js when Fable came out, and have been plugging away at it ever since, adding a ton more buildings, campaign mode, and lots of optimization to get it running on the steam deck. Now I'm pushing toward a demo launch. Let me know what you think!  
  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5023160/Mergeopolis/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5023160/Mergeopolis/)
